note: Ground truth authored from source semantics (ADR-044). `format` comes from the date-fns package, so it resolves to nothing even though tb/other.ts defines the repo's only `format`. `make` and `load` are each defined in tb/store.ts and tb/tools.ts, and this file imports both, so only the import each call goes through settles it. `fromBarrel` is imported through the barrel tb/index.ts, which only re-exports; its one definition is in tb/store.ts. `repo.save()` is a method on an `any` parameter: `save` is defined in tb/store.ts (imported) and tb/other.ts (not), and nothing says which, if either, is called.
